feature: Admin P47-12 PR A · Health polish: grid cells open Runs, footer Needs you line, Missed crawl tile, new failures in Needs you, Emails row
note: CONTACT_SHEET_ROLE=admin. Boards: 03-health/health-desktop (footer, Emails row), 03-health/tiles-in-each-state (Missed tile, failed tile's Needs you line), 03-health/health-mobile. Read-only. CANNOT BE MOCKED: /admin is a server component, so /v1/admin/crawl/batches, /v1/admin/needs-you?kind=venue-failing|venue-blocked and /v1/admin/notifications/delivery are all fetched on the server and a browser route mock never reaches them. The Missed, new-failures and Emails rows therefore shoot whatever the target database holds: Missed draws only when the newest nightly batch is last night's and didntStart (true on staging most nights, where no daily crawl starts); the Needs you lines draw only when last night has a Failed or Paused venue with an open venue-failing/venue-blocked item; Emails shows Sending, Quiet or N failed by real delivery. Each row's wait accepts any crawl-tile state, so the sheet never hangs on data; the reviewer reads the state off the testid. Unit tests (HealthTiles, VenueGrid, SiteCard, health-model) pin every state's copy. The Site card is desktop only (gap G12), so the Emails row has no phone shot.
